description: This file implements mailbox message handling in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, message matching, sending, receiving, and asynchronous message support.

methods.name: k_mbox_init
methods.description: Initializes mailbox queues and links object core if enabled.

methods.name: mbox_message_match
methods.description: Checks if sender and receiver message descriptors are compatible and updates their fields.

methods.name: mbox_message_dispose
methods.description: Disposes of a received message and notifies the sender.

methods.name: mbox_message_put
methods.description: Handles sending a message synchronously or asynchronously, including queue management and thread blocking.

methods.name: k_mbox_put
methods.description: Public API to send a message synchronously.

methods.name: k_mbox_async_put
methods.description: Public API to send a message asynchronously.

methods.name: k_mbox_data_get
methods.description: Copies message data to buffer and disposes of the message.

methods.name: mbox_message_data_check
methods.description: Checks if message data should be retrieved immediately or kept for later.

methods.name: k_mbox_get
methods.description: Receives a message, waiting if necessary, and retrieves data if requested.

methods.name: init_mbox_module
methods.description: Initializes the mailbox subsystem, creating message descriptor pool.

methods.name: init_mailbox_obj_core_list
methods.description: Initializes and links mailbox object core list if enabled.
